items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: The first time I heard him was at another gig with Vic Circh. Do you remember Vic Circh?

ctx.x: Minor’s Grill or Wang and Jean’s. And it was in the black section, you know. And the music was fantastic. You know you walk in there and it’s just great. But the overall feeling was great too in those days. Even as weird as it was then racially and all that, you know, it wasn’t that way when we were there. You know it was just the music and everybody having a good time. There was no like tension or any of that. You know. But the music was great and Gordon was usually playing drums. Gordon Smith. And the first…
Vic Circh. I just posted a video it’s Sal Amico and myself and JR playing at Bobby’s Restaurant and Vic came and he sang and he scatted. Oh my God.
